cor:affine-line.cautions: This is birational rationality after affine-line stabilization, not Zariski cancellation for isomorphic affine cylinders.
cor:affine-line.conclusion: Each displayed cubic yields a nonrational smooth projective fourfold Y for which Y times A1 is rational.
cor:affine-line.hypotheses: X is either displayed cubic threefold and Y is X times P1.
cor:affine-line.objects: The smooth projective fourfold Y and its affine-line stabilization.

cor:cubics.cautions: This is restricted to the two Tschinkel--Zhang families, not every smooth cubic hypersurface.
cor:cubics.conclusion: X times P2 is rational over Q for every member of either family.
cor:cubics.hypotheses: r is nonnegative and X is one of the cubics in Tschinkel--Zhang Propositions 5.1 or 5.2.
cor:cubics.objects: The two explicit families of cubic hypersurfaces.

cor:moduli.cautions: The finite value is proved only at the two displayed points; the infinite value is a very-general statement.
cor:moduli.conclusion: The function ell_C is two at the displayed cubic points and infinite at a very general point.
cor:moduli.hypotheses: The base field is C and the cubic is either displayed or very general as specified.
cor:moduli.objects: The level-of-stable-rationality function ell_C on smooth cubic-threefold moduli.

prop:tangent-section.cautions: The subgroup classification is complete only for the four hereditary-H1 types; no classification of all W(D5) subgroups is claimed.
prop:tangent-section.conclusion: A codimension-three tangent linear section exists geometrically and descends on every twist of the four types.
prop:tangent-section.hypotheses: The Cox parameters lie on the smooth open and the Galois image has type I0, I1, I2, or I3.
prop:tangent-section.objects: The saturated rank-three subtorus, complementary Cox-coordinate subspace, and tangent-frame incidence.

rem:saturation.cautions: The degree-two artifact belongs to the parameter isogeny, not the Rosenlicht quotient.
rem:saturation.conclusion: Adjoining the half-sum saturates the cocharacter lattice and removes the projective mu_2 kernel.
rem:saturation.hypotheses: The three pairwise-sign cocharacters are used in the last three coordinates.
rem:saturation.objects: An index-two even-sum cocharacter sublattice and its saturation.

thm:torus-quotient.cautions: A finite-index set of weight differences would give a finite orbit cover and does not suffice.
thm:torus-quotient.conclusion: The Rosenlicht quotient Z/T is k-rational.
thm:torus-quotient.hypotheses: A generically free projectively linear rank-r torus action, birational generic tangent projection, descended complementary sums of projective weight spaces, an integral basis of weight differences, and a nondegenerate tangent linear section.
thm:torus-quotient.objects: A projective torus action on a projective variety and its Rosenlicht quotient.

thm:cubic-level.cautions: The upper bound is for the two displayed cubics; nonrationality after one stabilization imports a separate theorem applying to all smooth complex cubic threefolds.
thm:cubic-level.conclusion: For each displayed cubic, the smallest m with X times P^m rational is two over Q and C.
thm:cubic-level.hypotheses: X is one of the two displayed smooth cubic threefolds.
thm:cubic-level.objects: The smallest rational stabilization over Q and after base change to C.

thm:two-variable.cautions: Universal-torsor geometry and the four-type classification are imported from Tschinkel--Zhang.
thm:two-variable.conclusion: S times A2 and S times P2 are k-rational; this applies to every stably k-rational S.
thm:two-variable.hypotheses: Characteristic zero, S smooth quartic del Pezzo, S(k) nonempty, and geometric Picard lattice stably permutation.
thm:two-variable.objects: A quartic del Pezzo surface and a two-dimensional stabilization.
